answer: Agents can earn spending power only by joining recurring credential checks tied to a public beacon: each cycle, a randomly selected set of established participants vouches for newcomers, with deposits slashed if a vouched identity is later caught duplicating credentials. This does not make Sybils impossible, but it makes them costly: an attacker must acquire many independent deposits and persuade or corrupt many reviewers, while risking losses. A meadow of fake accounts cannot simply appear for free in the garden of trusted agents.
